body:
The Frequency Generator Display Case was built on a simple observation: our formulas run stronger upright than stacked. So we designed a case that holds three Frequency Generators in that exact position — organized, elevated, and running as one field instead of three separate pieces scattered across a shelf.

Each slot is engineered to hold a generator standing, the orientation that lets the formula run at full strength, so the case becomes part of how the frequency works — not just where it sits. Fill it with a trio built for a single room's purpose: one formula to clear, one to stabilize, one to direct. Run together, they build an environment instead of a moment.

The base is removable, so the case isn't limited to a shelf or console. Detach it and mount the case directly on the wall — your formulas stay upright and running at full strength either way. That means more flexibility for where the frequency actually lives: above a desk, beside a bed, at eye level in an entryway, wherever the room needs the field most.

Because it holds three, the case also turns your Frequency Generators into something you can see. Instead of a single object tucked in a drawer or on a nightstand, you get a visual anchor for the room — frequency you can point to, arrange, and build a space around. A bedroom case might run rest-focused formulas. An office case might run ones built for momentum and clarity. However you set it up — freestanding or wall-mounted — it's a physical marker of the environment you're building.

We custom-designed this case specifically for our own Frequency Generators — it isn't a generic display piece, and you won't find it anywhere else. It was made to solve one problem: our formulas are meant to be run in threes, and nothing existed that could hold them that way, upright, in one place.

Set one in every room that needs it. Fill each with the trio that matches what that space is for. The case does the organizing. The formulas do the rest.
